hints.title: Consecutive Ones Precomputation
hints.text: Precalculate the number of consecutive ones extending to the right and downwards from every cell in the grid.

hints.title: Testing Square Candidates
hints.text: Iterate over candidate square side lengths from the maximum possible dimension down to 1.

hints.title: Four Border Verification
hints.text: For cell (r, c) and length d, verify that right[r][c] >= d, down[r][c] >= d, right[r + d - 1][c] >= d, and down[r][c + d - 1] >= d.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking each square border from scratch takes O(R * C * min(R, C)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Auxiliary right and down consecutive count tables enable O(1) verification for any candidate square.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should precompute directional prefix streaks to test candidate squares efficiently.
complexity.notes: Returns total cells in square: side length squared.
